## 1. Method
- Tool path: Grok Bot built-in public X tools (`x` namespace): `search_posts_all` (full archive, sort_order=recency, max_results=25 — connector cap, confirmed: a 100 request was lowered to 25), `get_posts_by_ids` (conversation_id hydration). The user-X plugin was not used. No browser.
- Fields requested: created_at, conversation_id, attachments (+ public_metrics, author_id, lang, entities, text on early pages); expansions referenced_posts, attachments.media_keys (+ author_id early). Observed API quirk: on ~half of returned pages the API omitted conversation_id / entities / lang / in_reply_to_user_id even though requested. Missing conversation_ids were filled by `get_posts_by_ids` on the first and last post of each 2-hour posting session (331 ids hydrated, all returned), then propagated within the session (flagged `inferred`).
- Volume forced time-windowing: query 1 was split into 30+ date windows (monthly, then sub-month for dense periods) each paged with meta.next_token until absent, plus 8 handoff-gap windows to close seams between windows. Every window was paged to exhaustion (empty page / no next_token).
- Post text: the API returns ~280 characters for long-form posts (note_post body was not returned when requested). Snippets below are therefore truncated at source.
- Approx. X read calls used by this pass: ~290 (daily counter read 711–717 of 1000 remaining near the end). No 429 rate-limit responses occurred.

## 5. Gaps, API errors, limits
- Query 3/7 (`from:grok to:539Labs`) was sampled, not fully paged (~140 Grok posts, 2026-10-07 → 2026-11-10 CST-ish), to preserve the shared 1000/day read budget; Grok-side replies are instead captured via the referenced-post expansion of every post he replied to (4686 referenced posts). Not captured: Grok replies he did not answer (typically the last reply of each thread) outside the sampled windows, and all pre-rename replies findable only by the old handle. Follow-up option: page `from:grok to:Brad75138648402` and the rest of query 3 on a later day.
- Long-form text truncated at ~280 chars by the API; note_post body not returned.
- conversation_id omitted by the API on ~half the pages; 2517 posts have a session-inferred conversation_id (flag `inferred` in Appendix A) — treat thread grouping for those as approximate.
- Referenced-post errors returned with data (posts skipped, not retried): Not Found (deleted/unavailable) 73 ids; Authorization Error 16 ids (protected/withheld parents); Forbidden 1; Field Hydration Error 1.
- No 429s; no queries returned 400 (query 2 operator was changed by design, see table).
- Media content (567 A posts with media) was not opened; whether any are Grok-chat screenshots is unverified.
- Query 2 matches have no visible "grok" in the returned (truncated) text for 15 of 22 posts — the match is presumably in the truncated remainder.

## 6. Briefing digest (for the team)
Arvin's public X account @539Labs has an extensive on-X conversation history with @grok. A full-archive pass on 2026-11-10 found 5603 of his posts that tag or reply to @grok, grouped into 458 threads, from 2025-11-12 02:01 CST to 2026-11-10 08:57 CST (America/Chicago). Volume peaked Dec 2025 – May 2026 (about 700–1,200 posts a month in Dec–Feb) and runs about 150–300 a month since June 2026. No posts sharing grok.com chat links and no "I asked Grok"-style posts were found; images attached to about a tenth of the posts were not inspected, so screenshot shares cannot be ruled out.

What the threads are: long multi-post sessions in which he posts derivations, theorem lists and manuscript excerpts and asks Grok to review his X account, pinned post, GitHub (539-Labs-Master) and Zenodo records, "retain all derivations", and discuss. He typically opens with "Cosmic Journey, pal?" and closes with thanks. Frequent subjects: the S²-11DM²ET-X framework (described as an extension of General Relativity), HQCC/HGCC, the 9 Maths of Unification and its Theorem Lemma Chain, the 17 Theorems of Entanglement, Orch-OR/consciousness (often tagging @StuartHameroff), Grokipedia, 539/T₃ constants, black holes and 3-adic/adelic constructions, and since July 2026 Resonant Algebra / Residual Ternary Algebra, Bridge C and Einstein–Hampton curvature (Lean files). Third parties are often tagged (e.g., @elonmusk, @CERN, @Cambridge_Uni, @physorg_com, @Grokipedia, @xai).

How Grok responded: through about May 2026 replies are mostly affirming and elaborating. From September 2026 Grok more often flags limits: external assumptions inserted by hand, steps that do not follow (e.g., misuse of the p-adic product formula), numerical mismatches (an echo-delay of ≈17.1 ms rather than the posted 4.12 ms), "word salad" for one rank-48 lattice passage, incomplete Lean formalization (only L5 finished of L1–L7), lack of peer review, and that internal constants and uniqueness claims remain framework-internal. It does confirm some elementary arithmetic (T3 map, 4880 = floor(e³·3⁵), the 539 packaging), and calls a 14.35 TeV spectral-wall prediction falsifiable. October–November 2026 threads touch Bridge C ("controlled by arithmetic, not by data"; "g_s coefficients terminate at 247 under T₃=539"), a Y-junction picture in the compact 11D geometry, and "Zenodo v15" open status.

Caveats: these are public posts and Grok replies, recorded as claims only; nothing here is adopted or graded. Grok replies captured mainly via the posts he answered; Grok-only replies are sampled. Earlier Grok replies address the account as @Brad75138648402 (apparent prior handle). Full per-thread and per-post lists, with links, are in the inventory file.
